begin_of_turn_query.content: Consider this: A patient, a traveler in this context, wants to book a flight using the card with id 'card_7629' and the access token 'abc123xyz', expiring on 10/2026, with CVV 456. They intend to fly from Los Angeles to Tokyo on December 15, 2026, in business class, estimated at $1,200.
